headline: Testing should evolve with your code
subheadline: Orbit was born from a simple frustration: AI helps you write code 10x faster, but testing hasn't kept up. We're fixing that.

paragraphs: Every development team faces the same problem. AI coding tools let you ship features in hours instead of days. But testing? That's still manual scripts, brittle selectors, and a QA bottleneck that gets worse the faster you build.

Orbit takes a fundamentally different approach. Instead of recording tests or crawling URLs, we read your codebase at the AST level — understanding routes, components, auth flows, and business logic the way a senior engineer would. Then we generate and execute comprehensive test plans automatically.
The result is a testing system that doesn't just find bugs — it understands your application deeply enough to anticipate where bugs will appear. And it updates itself every time you push code.

values.title: One Connection, Full Coverage
values.description: Connect your repo once. Orbit handles indexing, planning, generating, and running. You focus on building.

values.title: The AI Works in the Open
values.description: Every decision Orbit makes is visible and explainable. See what it found, why it prioritized it, and how it reached its conclusions.

values.title: You Stay in Control
values.description: Autonomous by default, configurable at every level. Set the model, override prompts, approve plans, exclude paths. Autonomy is a dial.

values.title: Cost is a First-Class Concern
values.description: Prompt caching, semantic dedup, smart batching, model routing. We obsess over keeping per-run costs low enough to test every PR.
